# ADR-001: Start with one district

- Date: 2026-09-22
- Status: Accepted
- Type: product
- Supersedes: none
- Source: product-strategy session 2026-09-22

## Context
Swaps need density; a city-wide launch would spread a small audience thin.

## Decision
Launch in Wrzeszcz (Gdańsk) only until swaps happen within a week of listing.

## Basis
F-1, A-2

## Alternatives considered
City-wide launch; online-only shipping swaps.

## Consequences
Growth is slow by design; marketing stays local.

## Revisit when
Median time from listing to swap is under 7 days for a month.

## Implementation
not started
